shape_scope: Only matched one-dimensional x/y and harmonic arrays, matched N-by-3 vectors, scalar properties, metadata N or N-by-3. No general broadcasting claim.
permitted: AST/compile/code-object inspection without executing shared code; isolated synthetic frames and counters; own callback proposal only.
forbidden: No shared import, tracing, height/direction/Fresnel body, installed real profiler, source arrays, RGB, filters, composites, fits or images.
stop: First synthetic validation failure or deadline; preserve and report. No optical dry run.
